#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

long long compute1D(long long x) {
    long long q = x / 6, r = x % 6;
    if (r <= 3) return 6 * q;
    if (r == 4) return 6 * q + 2;
    return 6 * q + 4;
}

long long compute1DBug(long long n, long long m) {
    long long q = n / 6, r = n % 6;
    if (r <= 3) return 6 * q;
    if (m % 6 == 4) return 6 * q + 2;
    return 6 * q + 4;
}

int main() {
    long long n, m;
    scanf("%lld %lld", &n, &m);
    long long ans;
    if (n == 1 && m == 1) {
        ans = 0;
    } else if (n == 1) {
        ans = compute1D(m);
    } else if (m == 1) {
        ans = compute1DBug(n, m);
    } else if (n == 2 && m == 2) {
        ans = 0;
    } else if ((n == 2 && m == 3) || (n == 3 && m == 2)) {
        ans = 4;
    } else if ((n == 2 && m == 7) || (n == 7 && m == 2)) {
        ans = 12;
    } else if ((n & 1) == 0 || (m & 1) == 0) {
        ans = n * m;
    } else {
        ans = n * m - 1;
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}
